name: Disease Spread Simulation
desc:
*
A silent killer is spreading fast. Can you stop it in time?
Strategize, contain and eradicate the disease with various equipment.
Use medicine, equipment and machines to save patients and stop the disease spreading.
*

*
The game starts with 100 NPCs plus players.
One person is infected.
The infection spreads to people nearby, especially those unprotected.
Lucky infected people become immune.
Immune people lose their immunity and the fallen are replaced.
The cycle continues until there are no infected.
Have fun.
